item.title: Snowball Earth may hide a far stranger climate cycle than anyone expected
item.description:
📝 Snowball Earth may hide a far stranger climate cycle than anyone expected Credit: MTU During the Sturtian glacial period during the Neoproterozoic Era, Earth underwent periods of global glaciation, which have been described as either "Snowball" and "Slushball" Earth scenarios. Yet, some forms of life persisted during the Sturtian glacial period. The team's model showed that the weathering of the Franklin Large Igneous Province triggered repeated cycles of glaciation, where CO2 would build up when LIP weathering halted during glaciation and then CO2 would get depleted by weathering again.
🔗 Read more: https://sciencex.com/news/2026-04-snowball-earth-stranger-climate.html

item.title: Follow-up to Carrot disclosure: Forgejo
item.description:
📝 I've learnt that the role of Forgejo security team is to "take care of security vulnerabilities and to handle sensitive security-related issues reported to security@forgejo. Various entities, including some with security teams, revised their judgment about what Forgejo is and isn't, which was the main goal of the previous blogpost. So I ended up sending and email to Forgejo security team, containing: an apology, a bit about my reasoning for proceeding with carrot disclosure, recommendations about what to harden/review, and a bunch of commented exploits/proof-of-concepts as attachment.
